title: Çırağan Palace
visualBrief: Complete historic principal Çırağan Palace exterior from both native clips: three projecting waterfront pavilion groups and two inset bays,two tall ornamental window stories above a low rusticated basement,paired slender columns/pilasters,original layered curved window-head frames,deep cornices and paneled attic,three closed shallow green/gray hipped roof groups,and the integral southwestern raised entrance/balcony with two genuinely divided supported exterior stair flights. All glazing and principal door are closed. No mapped or pictured open court is supported. Independent modern hotel,gardens,pool,quay,gates,helipad and estate buildings stay native. Original geometric trim replaces figurative carving,heraldry and inscriptions; interiors are outside scope.
